default_actions.speaker: COLLEAGUE
default_actions.text: You should get back to your cubicle, before the Guard Demon catches you slouching!

lens.speaker: CO-WORKER'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Every icon on my desktop is a secret shortcut to Minesweeper. No one must know!

hatemail.speaker: COLLEAGUE
hatemail.text: A letter to a thief... sorry, I think you've grossly overestimated my importance.

default_actions.speaker: CUBICLE MATE
default_actions.text: I really need to use the bathroom... but my next break isn't for another twelve centuries!

lens.speaker: CUBICLE MATE'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: All in all, I'm pretty certain that I hate Mondays.

hatemail.speaker: CUBICLE MATE
hatemail.text: A letter to a thief?! Oh no, I've been found out! I've been illegally pirating file-sharing software for years!

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: I don't think pirating the software itself is a crime, actually.

hatemail.speaker: CUBICLE MATE
hatemail.text: What're you, a legal scholar?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Is this the kind of twisted ethos that drives my captors...?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: KIND OF! BUT ACTUALLY THAT'S JUST A BAND I WAS INTO BACK IN HIGH SCHOOL. YOU SHOULD CHECK THEM OUT SOMETIME.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THAT'S NOT A PA SYSTEM. I USE THOSE SPEAKERS TO PUMP OUT INSPIRATIONAL HIP-HOP 'BEATZ'. DRIVES THE GUARD DEMONS WILD.

collision_actions.speaker: GUARD DEMON
collision_actions.text: WEOO WEEOO LACK OF WORKING DETECTED IN SECTOR 66, ESCORTING BACK TO CUBICLE ASAP

default_actions.speaker: CO-WORKER
default_actions.text: Good to meetcha! The name's Morven. I'm a plain ol' working stiff, like you.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: I bet you're thinking about trying to escape from this place, right? Well, don't think that. Baal's got this place sealed up tight.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Take that Guard Demon over there. If he spots you trying to pull a fast one, he'll haul your ball-shaped butt right back to your desk!

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Maybe if one of us held his eye shut, we'd have a chance... but, well, I'm sort of on lockdown at the moment.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: That Guard's not even the worst of what Baal keeps around, either. This place makes the other levels of Office Hell look like cakewalk!

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Well, enough said. You should head back to your cubicle and lay low... just like me...

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Unless you can snap his great big peeper shut, you can't slip past the Guard Demon. No sir.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Best stick to your cubicle and avoid making waves... hum de dum...

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Hey, you're a crack shot with that Stapler! I'll bet you've put some mileage on those things in your day.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN
default_actions.text: Well, if you make it out of this place, tell the world my story! ...But don't use my real name. Trying to keep a low profile. You understand.

stapler.speaker: MORVEN
stapler.text: Hey, d'you mind if I borrow that stapler for a while? Hmm? I'll owe ya for it! Well, the offer's open, anyway.

scissors.speaker: MORVEN
scissors.text: Hey, d'you mind if I steal those Scissors for a while? I'll give you a nickel for 'em! Well, let me know if you change your mind.

rope.speaker: MORVEN
rope.text: Don't suppose I could talk you into parting with that rope? Nah, I guess not. Those things do tend to come in handy.

mug.speaker: MORVEN
mug.text: You know, if that mug's taking up space in your inventory, I could watch it for a while. No? Just offering...

lens.speaker: MORVEN'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Heh... Baal and his cronies can look and look, but they'll never find me out.

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text:
'To: The Scandalous Supply-Snatchler'. 
 You don't mean to deliver this to me, do you?
Yes
hatemail.label: Accuse

hatemail.text: No
hatemail.label: NoAccuse

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: Morven. The janitor says he was robbed not far from here... and that he never saw the criminal's face.
hatemail.cage: I'd like to take his face...

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text:
Could that have been because the criminal... 
 ...HAD NO FACE TO SEE?!

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text:
. . . ha. Ha ha ha. 
 Don't be ridiculous, friend. The thief did have a face.

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: AND IT'S PAST TIME... I SHOW IT TO YOU.

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: BWA HA HA! No mere office drone am I... for I am Morven, greatest petty thief in all the underworld!!

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: Your reign of inconvenience is over, Snatchler! Fork over your stolen goods and answer to JUSTICE!
hatemail.cage: Nose. Skin. Teeth. It's coming off.

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text:
Oh? And whose justice is that, Pachinko Man? 
 By the laws of Ball Hell, I am less a fugitive than you are!

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: Do you see the brilliance of it? So long as everyone thinks I'm stuck in this cubicle, none of these fools will take any interest in me!

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: (H-he's right... boisterous accusations aside, I have no way of compelling him to do anything.)
hatemail.cage: And this whole time... you stand there... with this WHO ME expression... on your FACE!

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: WA HA HA! Even if Baal and his cronies decided to come after me, what would they do? Haul me back to my cubicle for slouching?!

hatemail.speaker: GUARD DEMON
hatemail.text: ...HAUL YOU BACK TO YOUR CUBICLE... FOR SLOUCHING?

hatemail.speaker: GUARD DEMON
hatemail.text: WEEOO WEEOO! SLOUCH DETECTED!

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: W-what? No, you blind idiot, that was a rhetorical statement! I'm already IN my cubicle!

hatemail.speaker: GUARD DEMON
hatemail.text: LIES FROM A SLOUCH AND A SASSMOUTH! IT'S BACK TO THE CUBICLE FOR YOU! GURAAHHHHH!!!

hatemail.speaker: BAAL
hatemail.text: HUH. WELL, I CAN'T SAY EXACTLY WHERE MY GUARD DEMON IS HAULING THAT GUY, BUT I'M THINKIN' IT'LL BE PRETTY FAR FROM HIS CUBICLE.

hatemail.speaker: BAAL
hatemail.text: INCIDENTALLY, WHAT THE CRAP WAS ALL OF THAT? DID SOMEONE SURGICALLY IMPLANT A BACKBONE IN YOU WHEN I WASN'T LOOKING?

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: ...I watch a lot of procedural dramas.
hatemail.cage: I could eat a peach for hours.

hatemail.speaker: BAAL
hatemail.text: OF COURSE YOU DON'T! MORVEN IS A MODEL EMPLOYEE. JUST LOOK AT THIS GUY!

hatemail.speaker: MORVEN
hatemail.text: *whistles non-chalantly*

hatemail.speaker: BAAL
hatemail.text: THERE, YOU SEE? WHISTLING NON-CHALANTLY IS THE INDELIBLE MARK OF A PERSON NOT HIDING ANYTHING.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: SNEAKING OFF, EH? YOU'LL NEVER MAKE IT PAST THE PROUD AND MIGHTY GUARD DEMON! ITS GREAT EYE IS EVER-SCANNING FOR LOAFERS AND DUTY-SHIRKERS.

default_actions.speaker: GUARD DEMON
default_actions.text: WEEO WEEO SOMEONE PLEASE TURN THE LIGHTS BACK ON, I AM WORRIED THAT I AM OVERLOOKING SHENANIGANS

stapler.speaker: BAAL
stapler.text: YOU'VE BLINDED MY POOR GUARD DEMON. . . AN IMPRESSIVE OPENING GAMBIT!

stapler.speaker: BAAL
stapler.text: BUT DON'T GET TOO COMFORTABLE. I'VE GOT PLENTY OF OTHER TRICKS UP MY SLEEVES TO DEAL WITH SLACKERS LIKE YOU!

stapler.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
stapler.text: He's too far away for my stubby Pachinko-arms to reach...!

stapler.speaker: BAAL
stapler.text: HASN'T HE HAD ENOUGH?! SHEESH, AND THEY CALL ME A SADIST! CORRECTLY! HEY, WE SHOULD COMPARE NOTES SOMETIME.

scissors.speaker: GUARD DEMON
scissors.text: GURAAHH THOSE TINY ROUNDED SCISSORS WILL NOT AVAIL YOU, DISGRUNTLED EMPLOYEE!! I'MA KNOCK YOU BACK TO YOUR CUBICLE RIGHT QUICK

scissors.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
scissors.text: B-but I stabbed him right in the eye!

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: ...WHICH IS THE STRONGEST POINT ON THE GUARD DEMON'S BODY. DUH.

scissors.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
scissors.text: He's too far away for my stubby Pachinko-arms to reach...!

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: HASN'T HE HAD ENOUGH?! SHEESH, AND THEY CALL ME A SADIST! CORRECTLY! HEY, WE SHOULD COMPARE NOTES SOMETIME.

lens.speaker: GUARD DEMON'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: WHY NO ONE SEE... GUARD DEMON NEED LOVE TOO?

hatemail.speaker: GUARD DEMON
hatemail.text: GURAAHH WHY YOU SHOWING GUARD DEMON THIS LETTER? I NO CAN READ!!

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: Oh! Sorry. I forgot your eye had been stapled shut.

hatemail.speaker: GUARD DEMON
hatemail.text:
...YES. THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT I MEANT. 
 TOTALLY LITERATE OVER HERE. GUWARR.
